title: Time tracking function on Apple Watch is broken.
body: This is a good APP, very easy to add habit and keep track of it. However, the time tracking function on Apple Watch is broken. I have added a habit of reading 10 minutes of book every day,. However, when I start the time tracking on Apple Watch, it only counts down when an Apple Watch display is on. As a result, it takes twenty minutes to count down for ten minutes.

title: syncing between iOS and macOS
body: I just bought the app after reading the book Atomic Habit and hoping to establish some good habits. I like it that it looks simple and doing what it should do, the apps on iPhone and   watch worked well, but the mac app didn't sync well with the phone and watch for the habit "drink 8 cups of water" which I added via the preset template.

title: Best habit tracking app to use with Apple watch
body:
This is the best habit tracking app I have ever seen and it can truly help forming good habits with its reminding function (esp with the apple watch).

Some suggestions tho:
1. more tasks can be added 
2. Can choose the reminders for "specific days in a month" for people who have a relatively irregular schedule
author: Fiona_leung

title: All greatness begins with small, positive habit
body: This app helps you do just that. I was slacking at all fronts in the past decade, only too late - but better than never - to realise it is all these little daily routine practices to be the hook to get me back on track and achieve many large, ambitious goals.
